author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Oracle E-Business Suite flaw CVE-2026-46817 is under active attack, with about 950 vulnerable internet-facing instances still exposed. The flaw affects Oracle Payments versions 12.2.3 through 12.2.15 and allows unauthenticated attackers to take over vulnerable […]
title: Oracle E-Business Suite Flaw Under Active Attack, 950 Systems Exposed

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: CISA confirms BlueHammer (CVE-2026-33825) is now used in ransomware attacks to gain SYSTEM privileges through Microsoft Defender. BlueHammer, tracked as CVE-2026-33825, has moved from proof-of-concept noise to real ransomware attacks in the wild, the US CISA confirms. BlueHammer allows attackers to escalate privileges locally in Microsoft Defender. The vulnerability, along with two other zero-days dubbed […]
title: CISA Warns BlueHammer Flaw Is Now Exploited in Ransomware Attacks

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: RustDuck is a small, evolving DDoS botnet migrating to Rust. It uses advanced encryption, anti-analysis evasion, and exploits known IoT flaws. title: RustDuck: The Botnet That’s Still Small but Engineering Like It Plans to Grow
